news.headline: India bonds reverse intraday gains to end lower as profit booking takes center stage
news.summary: Indian government bonds faced a setback as profit-seeking traders reacted to earlier gains, with the benchmark bond yield increasing to 7.2858% compared to the previous closure. The fluctuations in crude prices have influenced the market outlook on the Reserve Bank of India, prompting analysts to predict a potential rate increase in December amidst rising retail inflation.

news.headline: Anthropic IPO: Why Wall Street is betting big on Claude AI maker
news.summary: Anthropic is preparing for a blockbuster IPO that could value the Claude AI maker at up to $1.6 trillion. Strong investor demand, strategic stakes held by Amazon and Google, and bullish analyst forecasts are driving interest, although governance and profitability risks remain.

news.headline: Max Healthcare among 10 Nifty stocks rallied up to 22% in 1 month. Did you miss the rally?
news.summary: Nifty has surged impressively, claiming the title of the top-performing major equity market lately. Max Healthcare Institute reported a striking gain of almost 22% over the past month. InterGlobe Aviation and Mahindra & Mahindra followed suit with increases of approximately 20% and 17% respectively. The State Bank of India, a prominent public-sector entity, saw an uplift of about 15% as well.

news.headline: PI Industries among 5 stocks hitting 52-week low; slipped up to 26% in a month
news.summary: Five BSE 500 stocks, including PI Industries, Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail and Thermax, hit fresh 52-week lows as the market weakened, with losses reaching 26% in a month.

news.headline: Rupee ends flat after hitting seven-month high as firmer dollar offsets inflows
news.summary: The Indian rupee closed almost flat after peaking at a seven-month high during early trading on Wednesday. Robust foreign investments in local stocks provided a boost, but a stronger dollar capped further gains. The dollar index rose by 0.2%, reaching its highest since April 2025 due to anticipations of accelerated rate hikes.

news.headline: Govt weighs tax tweaks to boost stock trading, curb derivatives: Report
news.summary: The government is reviewing proposals to cut securities transaction tax on cash equities by 50% while raising levies on derivatives to curb speculative trading and encourage broader market participation. Officials are also considering a reduction in long-term capital gains tax. The recommendations will be presented to Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman ahead of Budget 2027.

news.headline: Tata Motors among 5 stocks closing above 200-DMA
news.summary: Five Nifty500 stocks gained over 3% and closed above their respective 200-day moving averages on November 17, according to StockEdge’s technical scan, signalling a potential shift in their broader price trends.

news.headline: SpiceJet board approves up to Rs 5,500 crore fundraise amid operational challenges; stock hits 5% upper circuit
news.summary: SpiceJet's board of directors announced a fundraising plan to raise up to Rs 5,500 crore. The airline's shares have surged significantly, hitting the upper circuit for six consecutive sessions. Flight cancellations and operational disruptions have caused significant challenges for SpiceJet in recent days. The airline is focusing on rebuilding capacity and ensuring operational reliability going forward. The fundraising aims to strengthen its financial position and support fleet expansion efforts.

news.headline: How Ashish Kacholia, Radhakishan Damani, Madhusudan Kela and other ace investors reshuffled their portfolios in Q2
news.summary: Mukul Agrawal, Akash Bhanshali and Ashish Kacholia emerge as the biggest portfolio gainers among prominent individual investors in the September quarter. Meanwhile, Radhakishan Damani records the steepest decline. The analysis examines their portfolio values, top stock holdings and changes in shareholding across listed companies.

news.headline: 16 microcap stocks surge up to 390% in CY26, emerge as multibaggers
news.summary: The Nifty Microcap 250 has outperformed the benchmark Nifty 50 in CY26, with several constituents delivering multibagger returns. Sixteen microcap stocks have more than doubled investors' wealth so far this year, led by Sigma Advanced Systems, while nearly 50 stocks in the index have gained over 50%.

news.headline: India bonds rise tracking easing crude oil, US Treasury yields
news.summary: The Indian bond market is experiencing a positive shift, with bond yields decreasing as oil prices and Treasury yields fall. The 2036 benchmark bond yield is now at 7.2393%, reflecting a minor drop. Additionally, crude oil prices have plummeted more than 20% since their October peaks, providing a temporary buffer against inflation.

news.headline: SanDisk stock selloff deepens: What's driving the crash?
news.summary: SanDisk shares have plunged 50% in three months amid AI spending concerns, NAND oversupply fears and investor selling. Upcoming stock split and earnings outlook remain key investor focus.

news.headline: Global money rushes back into Indian stocks at record pace
news.summary: Foreign investors have poured a record $9.61 billion into Indian equities so far in November, marking a sharp reversal after months of selling. Improving earnings prospects, easing crude prices and weakness in the global AI trade are driving renewed interest, with India emerging as one of Asia’s preferred equity markets.

news.headline: Tata Chemicals among 4 stocks that show RSI Trending Up
news.summary: “RSI trending up” means that the Relative Strength Index (RSI) values are increasing, indicating strengthening momentum in the stock's price. The RSI is a technical indicator commonly used by traders to assess price momentum and trend strength.

news.headline: Prime Focus among 4 stocks that closed above VWAP
news.summary: Four Nifty500 stocks, including Prime Focus, RHI Magnesita India, Laurus Labs and Tata Investment Corporation, closed more than 1.5% above their respective volume-weighted average prices (VWAPs) on November 18. The technical scan by StockEdge highlights stocks that ended the trading session above their volume-weighted average traded prices.
